The Program Analyst (Performance) contributes to the agency's strategic planning, performance management, and the digital transformation of how the Peace Corps conducts its business. Major duties fall into three areas: 1.

Data Analysis, Reporting & Visualization- Gathers, transforms, and analyzes large or complex datasets to produce clear, decision-ready insights, using AI-assisted tools to accelerate data transformation (e.g., writing and refining queries) while owning the analysis and interpretation.

Builds reports, dashboards, and visualizations using business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) so leaders and staff have ready access to reliable data Responds to data and analysis requests from internal staff, leadership, and the public, tailoring findings to the audience.

Automates recurring data collection, analysis, and reporting to improve speed and accuracy. 2.

Enabling Digital Transformation Across the Agency- Partners with offices across the agency and works closely with the Office of Information Systems (OIS) to ensure the Office of Planning and Performance (OPP) and agency staff have the data, tools, and workflows they need to do their jobs well.

Identifies opportunities to adopt new tools and better ways of working, and helps colleagues learn and adopt them. Contributes to responsible data governance and data-sharing practices in coordination with the analyst who leads that work, ensuring efforts connect to the broader transformation agenda. 3.

Strategic & Performance Planning- Supports development, review, and reporting for agency-wide strategic and performance products, including the Annual Performance Plan, Annual Performance Report, and quarterly performance reviews, consistent with OMB and Congressional requirements and timelines.

Helps interpret federal performance management law, policy, and practice and translate it into practical guidance for agency leaders and goal leads. Supports the design of accountability and strategic-alignment systems that help the agency execute on its priorities.

This vacancy is being announced at: two grade level(s).

Specialized Experience at the FP-4 (GS-11) Level: To qualify for this position at the FP-4 level, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower level in the normal line of progression, FP-5 or GS-9.

This experience must be directly related to the work of the position and must have equipped you with the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to successfully perform the duties of the role.

Specialized experience includes: Assisting with analytical or evaluative work related to program performance, organizational effectiveness, or strategic planning; Gathering and transforming data and preparing draft reports, summaries, or visualizations; and Using data, spreadsheet, or business intelligence tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or comparable tools) to organize or present information. ~OR~ Ph.

D or equivalent doctoral degree OR 3 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree OR LL.M. in a field which demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the work of the position.

Specialized Experience at the FP-3 (GS-13) Level: To qualify for this position at the FP-3 level, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower level in the normal line of progression, FP-4 or GS-11.

This experience must be directly related to the work of the position and must have equipped you with the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to successfully perform the duties of the role.

Specialized experience includes: Developing or analyzing performance measures and preparing comprehensive reports, briefings, or recommendations that inform program or organizational decisions; and Using data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Python or R, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable tools) to analyze complex datasets and communicate findings to varied audiences. ~OR~ A combination of education and experience ~AND~ Time-in-Grade Requirements: Current or former Federal employees, including Peace Corps employees, must meet applicable Time-in-Grade requirements to be eligible for this position.

For positions above the FP-09 (GS-05) level, you must have completed at least one year (52 weeks) at the next lower grade in the normal line of progression for the position to which you are applying.

What We're Looking for in Top Candidates We're seeking a curious, adaptable analyst who is genuinely comfortable using and learning new tools - and who is excited, not hesitant, about working with AI as part of everyday practice.

This role is a strong fit for someone energized by emerging technology; it is not well suited to applicants who prefer to avoid AI-assisted tools. Strong candidates will bring several of the following.

We don't expect any one person to bring them all, we expect the ability to learn the rest quickly: - Comfort using AI tools to support data transformation (e.g., generating and refining queries) and document preparation - Experience with data and analytics tools, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new tools quickly - Familiarity with cloud data architecture - Knowledge of UI/UX and/or data visualization principles - Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software - People analytics / applicant tracking systems (ATS) - Marketing analytics - Survey research - Product development Please note: If you are qualifying based on education or a combination of education and experience, please review the "Education" section of this announcement.

Experience that satisfies the Specialized Experience requirements must be clearly documented in your resume. Failure to provide this information may result in disqualification. Please review the "Required Documents" section of this announcement for further information on resume requirements.

Specialized experience may be gained in the public sector, private sector, or through volunteer service (e.g., National Service programs such as Peace Corps or AmeriCorps, or other organizations such as professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, or social groups). One year of experience refers to full-time work.

Part-time work will be credited on a prorated basis. For more details on qualification requirements, refer to the OPM Qualifications Standards Handbook for General Schedule Positions, available on the OPM web site.

As a MANAGEMENT ANALYST, GS-0343-10, you will retrieve and analyze maintenance data, present results to management; interprets findings from maintenance data and the use of statistical techniques; identifies trends and significant deviations from plans, schedules, and workload estimates; analyzes deficiencies in areas such as material consumption and training, workload, scheduling, management, and maintenance resources use; analyzes impact on the maintenance mission and the results of corrective actions; prepares written reports of analyses and studies; capture specific data monthly for inclusion into the Aircraft Predictive Model (APM) requirement and Readiness Informed Metric (RIM); designs summary reports to meet recurring management needs; controls, manages and maintains the Maintenance Information System(s) (MIS); develops policies and procedures for MIS application within maintenance activities; oversees the identification and correction of file errors within the database; controls, develops and coordinates maintenance data systems and requirements; determines data processing requirements and relates functional aspects to specific hardware and software capabilities; controls automated management product retrieval and advises maintenance supervision on automated information use; identifies data system problems, coordinating with data automation monitors, and submits system deficiency reports; identifies new information requirements, submits information system requirement documents, and coordinates with data system development services for implementing new programs; manage the Data Integrity Team (DIT) program for the Maintenance Group Commander and provide updates and metrics to maintenance supervision; responsible for building, analyzing, and programing system queries to generate local and command level data reports for consumption and information generation in multiple systems; senior level requests ranging from senior wing leadership, the NGB, and MAJCOM levels; conducts Special Studies to assess Health of the Unit Readiness (HUR) / Health of Fleet (HOF); performs in-depth comprehensive analysis of complex and prioritized unit readiness issues; in addition, develops a semi-annual report for presentation to senior leadership; develops complex problem solutions to address and resolve readiness issues as the Office of Primary Responsibility (OPR), while utilizing specific training and knowledge to develop a comprehensive readiness management plan; collect specific metrics for inclusion into the RIM/7401 monthly report, while searching for trends and validating accuracy; analyzes performance data to determine manpower, equipment, and facilities maintenance capabilities; provides in-depth analysis of maintenance manning and equipment, material and facility limitations to determine the impact each has on unit and mission effectiveness; isolates trends and determines material and personnel efficiency and effectiveness; develops methods for improving maintenance planning and personnel efficiency and effectiveness; develops methods for improving maintenance planning and programming procedures to ensure optimum use of maintenance resources; perform other duties as assigned.
Minimum Requirements: Experience, education, or training in administrative, professional, investigative, technical or other responsible work which demonstrates analytical ability and a practical and theoretical knowledge of the functions, processes and principles of management. Experience using computer and automation systems.

Specialized Experience: Must have at least 24 months experience which has provided a working knowledge of the National Guard organizational structures, functions, procedures, and techniques. Experience analyzing, interpreting and developing policies and procedures of local management.

Serves as an Inventory Management (IM) Supervisor for DLA Energy; this is a supervisory position primarily responsible for providing direct and operational oversight of assigned Inventory Management team members at the site.
Ensures the proper resources and mechanisms are in place to support the development and ongoing maintenance of Inventory Management policies, business rules, system enhancements, and training, under direction from higher management authority.
Manages the analyses of Inventory Management process issues impacting their assigned areas and oversees team members in formulating recommendations, execute actions, and monitor results.
Escalates Enterprise Business Solutions (EBS) process and system related issues to the Inventory Management Site Process Lead and/or Enterprise Process Integrator/Owner office.
Ensures close working relationships and coordinates actions with their counterparts and Process Management team members assigned to other EBS process areas and/sites, to transition business decisions.
Collaborates with members of the Partner Engagement and Supplier Operations organizations on items with an impact to end-users, partners, and other external stakeholders.
Develops innovative responses and procedures to overcome process problems and to integrate the EBS enterprise approach to logistics systems and operations in process execution at their site.
Directs the design and execution of training on new ways of doing business; conducting outreach and education with stakeholders to achieve buy-in and explain impacts; and networking with other field activities to ensure a smooth transition.
Works within the Inventory Management community and across business processes both within the site and across the enterprise in directing the development of new or revised procedures and/or systems changes to meet identified requirements.
Ensures processes follow applicable laws/policies/regulations, well documented and regularly maintained (e.g., process system memorandum, functional system specifications, Standard Operating Procedures, and process related training).

Due to the mission of the National Cemetery, the cemetery cannot be closed for more than 2 consecutive days at any given time. All staff is required to work Memorial Day and Veteran's Day each year. Staff will be required to work overtime, weekends and holidays when necessary to meet the needs of the cemetery. Occasionally staff may be called back to the facility to perform emergency overtime work.

The professionals at the National Security Agency (NSA) have one common goal: to protect our nation. The mission requires a strong offense and a steadfast defense. The offense collects, processes and disseminates intelligence information derived from foreign signals for intelligence and counterintelligence purposes.

The defense prevents adversaries from gaining access to sensitive or classified national security information. Depending on education and experience, the following opportunities will apply: Target Systems Analysts (TSAs) are hired into positions directly supporting a technical mission office.

The work done by our Analysts is of the utmost importance to National Security and the defense of our Nation. Only the most skilled and dedicated are able to join our team. If you have what it takes please apply and be part of the agency that is on the front line of Modern Warfare.

TSAs focus on telemetry signals used in the defense industry that includes spacecraft monitoring, aircraft development, and weapons system testing. Telemetry is used by manned and unmanned spacecraft for various data transmissions including monitoring the health of astronauts as well as the health and status of the actual spacecraft.

Telemetry for weapons testing includes monitoring temperatures, vibrations, accelerations, positions and status of various subsystems. Telemetry is also used for range safety related to flight testing to determine flight termination criteria.

The role of a TSA is to reverse engineer the telemetry data transmitted by various systems to determine the performance characteristics and capabilities of these systems.
FULL PERFORMANCE Entry is with a degree (Bachelors, Masters or Doctorate) plus 3 years of relevant experience.

Our strategic investments in decoupled modern architecture and AI-enhanced engineering workflows empower our teams to rapidly deploy scalable, premium-quality products. The Mission We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst who excels at bridging product strategy, engineering, data, and AI-augmented development.

Forget traditional requirements-gathering roles that focus heavily on meeting notes and passing off tickets. In this position, you will be deeply integrated into a high-velocity engineering organization, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, DevOps, and UX to turn strategic concepts into precise, actionable technical architectures.

As a force multiplier for the engineering team, you will decode complex business challenges into clear, implementation-ready specifications, utilize AI tools to expedite analysis, and maximize the time engineers spend writing code rather than untangling ambiguity.

Why This Role Matters As Life Science Connect evolves into a modern data authority, our ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality depends on exceptional product definition and technical clarity.

The Senior IT Business Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring engineers spend their time building innovative solutions—not deciphering requirements.

If you enjoy solving complex business problems, partnering closely with engineers, embracing AI as a productivity multiplier, and helping shape the next generation of intelligent digital products, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Actually Do

Translate Strategy into Engineering Execution: Partner with Product Leadership and Engineering to transform strategic initiatives into clear technical requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, and acceptance criteria that engineers can immediately build from.

Drive AI-Augmented Analysis: Use modern AI tools to rapidly produce requirements, process models, technical documentation, and data mappings while maintaining exceptional structural accuracy and logical consistency.

Design Intelligent Product Workflows: Analyze complex business processes and design scalable workflows that leverage identity, personalization, analytics, AI services, and customer intelligence across our product ecosystem.

Own Product Specifications: Produce implementation-ready documentation including PRDs, functional specifications, user stories with rigorous acceptance criteria, API contracts, process flows, and data mappings.

Partner Deeply with Engineering: Work directly alongside Full Stack Engineers to clarify requirements, answer implementation questions, refine technical solutions, and remove ambiguity before development begins.

Enable Data Intelligence: Collaborate with Data Engineering to define modern data models, ingestion patterns, warehouse requirements, reporting needs, and customer intelligence workflows while ensuring data quality throughout the product lifecycle.

Validate What We Build: Support testing, feature validation, and release readiness by ensuring delivered functionality aligns perfectly with business objectives and technical specifications.

Improve How We Work: Continuously improve documentation standards, Agile practices, AI-enabled delivery workflows, and product discovery processes to help the entire engineering organization move faster with greater confidence.

La société **PQM Consulting AG**, basée à Pfäffikon SZ, est une entreprise informatique renommée spécialisée dans l'assurance qualité et la gestion de la qualité. L'entreprise offre à ses clients un soutien professionnel pour optimiser leurs exigences de qualité et divise ses compétences clés en quatre composantes principales : gestion de projet/risque, gestion de la qualité, gestion des exigences ainsi que gestion des processus.
Pour un projet client externe dans la grande région de Zurich, nous recherchons **à partir du** **01.09.2026** une personne expérimentée et compétente pour le poste de Business Analyst au niveau Expert (8-12 ans d'expérience).
**Tâches principales :**
*
* Analyse des processus liés aux logiciels actuels (par ex. déclaration des besoins, acquisition, déploiement, utilisation, maintenance, résiliation/retrait) et identification des lacunes du point de vue de la gestion des actifs logiciels (SAM).
*
* Conception et modélisation d'une gestion ciblée des actifs logiciels tout au long du cycle de vie du logiciel, incluant les rôles, responsabilités, points de contrôle et interfaces (notamment IT, achats, finance, sécurité, conformité).
*
* Collecte, coordination et documentation des exigences fonctionnelles et techniques pour un futur outil SAM (par ex. gestion des licences, inventaire, gestion des contrats, reporting) - incluant la priorisation des exigences minimales (MVP).
*
* Conception de l'intégration de l'outil SAM dans le paysage système existant (comme le système ITSM ou SAP Ariba) ainsi que définition des besoins en données, interfaces et exigences de qualité.
*
* Élaboration de bases décisionnelles (business case, vision cible), concepts fonctionnels et documents de formation ainsi qu'accompagnement de la sélection de l'outil et des premières étapes de mise en œuvre.
*

*
* Expérience de plusieurs années en tant que Business Engineer dans un environnement agile (de préférence SAFe), idéalement avec un focus sur la gestion des actifs logiciels, la gestion des licences ou la gestion financière IT.
*
* Capacité marquée à modérer différents intervenants (business, IT, architecture, achats, finance, risques, management), préparer des décisions et communiquer et documenter des sujets complexes de manière claire, adaptée au public et compréhensible.
*
* Expérience approfondie dans la mise en place ou le développement de la gestion des actifs logiciels ou de la gestion des licences, incluant la conception de processus de bout en bout ; une expérience avec des outils SAM (par ex. Flexera, ServiceNow SAM, Snow, USU ou solutions comparables) est un plus.
*
* Forte capacité analytique et conceptuelle combinée à du pragmatisme : vous pensez en termes d-utilité, d-impact, de risque et de coûts, remettez en question les hypothèses et établissez des priorités.

Senior Technical Business Analyst Digital Identity \& Open Banking (a) (80\-100%)
=================================================================================
Die Kantonalbank ist die zweitgrösste Universalbank und die grösste Kantonalbank der Schweiz. Mit starker regionaler Verankerung im Wirtschaftsraum Zürich steht sie seit über 150 Jahren für Stabilität, Vertrauen und nachhaltiges Handeln. Sie verbindet wirtschaftliche Stabilität und langfristige Orientierung mit der konsequenten Weiterentwicklung ihrer Angebote. Das Ziel: persönlich wie digital ein überzeugendes Kundenerlebnis zu bieten.
Genau hier setzt der Bereich Client Channels an. Im Fokus stehen zentrale digitale und physische Touchpoints zwischen der ZKB und ihren Kundinnen und Kunden, die Bedürfnisse mit Technologie, Prozessen, User Experience, Security und Betrieb verbinden. Dazu gehören unter anderem E\-Banking, Mobile Banking sowie digitale Eröffnungs\-, Onboarding\- und Lifecycle\-Prozesse.
Innerhalb von Client Channels verantwortet das Team ID Management \& API Banking den sicheren Zugang zu den digitalen Bankdienstleistungen der ZKB. Im Zentrum stehen das Customer Identity \& Access Management (CIAM), also die Verwaltung digitaler Kundenidentitäten und deren Zugriffsberechtigung, sowie die Open\-Banking\-Plattform. Fachteam und DevOps arbeiten eng zusammen und begleiten ihre Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zum stabilen Betrieb.
Für das fachseitige Team suchen wir dich als erfahrene Persönlichkeit an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT.
**Deine Herausforderung**
* Aktive Mitgestaltung der Open\-Banking\-Plattform und der Lösungen für digitale Kundenidentitäten und deren Authentisierung
* Erhebung, Analyse und Modellierung fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen sowie Überführung in umsetzbare Features, User Stories, Spezifikationen und Testfälle
* Technische Leitung von Arbeitspaketen, Teilprojekten und parallel laufenden Vorhaben von der Konzeption bis zum Go\-live
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung und Unterstützung bei Testing, Rollouts und der Einführung neuer Lösungen
* Sicherstellung eines stabilen Betriebs sowie Einhaltung regulatorischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Anforderungen
* Regelmässige Übernahme der operativen Verantwortung inklusive Analyse und Koordination fachlicher und technischer Störungen im Second\- und Third\-Level\-Support
* Beratung interner und externer Partner zu Anforderungen, Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und notwendigen Entscheidungen
**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**
* Abgeschlossenes Studium (Universität, FH) in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder ähnlich
* Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im technisch geprägten Business Engineering/Business Analyse, in der technischen Projektleitung oder im technischen Application Management
* Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Identity \& Access Management oder im plattformbezogenen Open\-Banking\- beziehungsweise Open\-Finance\-Umfeld
* Fähigkeit, Anforderungen so zu spezifizieren, dass Entwicklungsteams daraus konkrete Lösungen umsetzen können
* Erfahrung in Prozess\- und Datenanalyse sowie in Anforderungsermittlung und Modellierung, z.B. mit UML, BPMN oder Mock\-ups
* Gutes Verständnis für Backend\-Systeme, APIs, Authentifizierung und Security; Kenntnisse in OAuth, OpenID Connect oder Consent Management sind von Vorteil
* Erfahrung in der Koordination technischer Vorhaben und in agilen Arbeitsmodellen wie Scrum oder SAFe
* Analytische, eigenverantwortliche und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Drive, klarer Kommunikation und Freude am Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern
* Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1\-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse
Als Senior Technical Business Analyst gestaltest du geschäftskritische Plattformen, die den sicheren Zugang zu den digitalen Angeboten der ZKB ermöglichen. Dabei verbindest du technisches Verständnis mit konzeptioneller Stärke und begleitest deine Themen bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Reizt dich eine Aufgabe mit viel Eigenverantwortung und direktem Einfluss auf digitale Kundenschnittstellen?

Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-11 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-9. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.

You may qualify based on your experience and/or education as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-9 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: Serve as a technical advisor to senior facility leadership providing guidance, recommendations and monitoring in the implementation, management, and evaluation of VERA oversight programs and ensure that the programs meet required standards and/or criteria; Conduct special studies and analysis, including feasibility studies, cost/benefit analysis, etc. and submit findings, results, and recommendations in a timely, concise, an accurate manner; Develop databases that support benchmarking of data, including financial data, patient populations and workload data; Responsible for the design and development of reports and databases, translating data into meaningful management information that is made available to a wide variety of constituents, including oversight bodies and stakeholders; Coordinate and disseminate data, special projects, and other information pertaining to relevant program responsibilities with medical center staff for review and/or action; Work closely with the Health Information Management Section (HIMS) to correct discrepancies and work through the identified areas of risk; Identify data required for use in the management and direction of programs, develop new or modified administrative program policies, regulations, goals, or objectives; Perform clinical or administrative training on areas of improvement based on the analysis performed within VERA.

OR, Education: Applicants may substitute education for the required experience. To qualify based on education for this grade level you must have a Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree, or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree, or LL.M., if related.

OR, Combination: Applicants may also combine education and experience to qualify at this level. You must have a combination of specialized experience and education beyond successfully completed post-high school education.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.
Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme.
Das Projekt
Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.
Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.
Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.
Aufgaben
Die Rolle
Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.
Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.
Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.
Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.
Deine Aufgaben
Anforderungen durch Workshops, Interviews und Prozessbeobachtung herausarbeiten – auch wenn Prozesse bisher kaum dokumentiert sind
Ist-Prozesse sowie fachliche Regeln und Entscheidungslogiken analysieren und modellieren, insbesondere mit BPMN
Datenobjekte, Beziehungen, Quellsysteme und Schlüssel hinter einem Prozess identifizieren und visualisieren
Datenflüsse nachvollziehen und Auswirkungen von Datenqualität und Datenverfügbarkeit auf Anforderungen erkennen
Prozessdiagramme, Fachkonzepte, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Präsentationen erstellen
Stakeholder-Kommunikation und Erwartungsmanagement für Deine Use Cases übernehmen
Business Cases sowie KI-, Datenschutz- und Data-Governance-Freigaben beim Kunden begleiten
Fachliche Grundlagen für Scoping, Aufwandsschätzungen und Angebote erarbeiten
Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte nachhalten sowie Blocker sichtbar machen und vorantreiben
Gemeinsam mit dem Team prüfen, wie Lösungen auf weitere Fachbereiche oder Länder skaliert werden können
Das heutige Team
Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Delivery-Team mit Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, AI Engineering sowie Backend- und Frontend-Entwicklung.
Qualifikation
Must-haves
Projekterfahrung in Business Analyse, Prozessberatung, Requirements Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
Erfahrung in der Modellierung von Prozessen und Entscheidungslogiken, idealerweise mit BPMN
Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Datenflüsse : Du kannst Objekte, Beziehungen, Quellen und Schlüssel herausarbeiten und nachvollziehen, was mit Daten in einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten passiert
Grundverständnis für KI und KI-gestützte Automatisierung , insbesondere hinsichtlich Datenqualität, Ergebnisqualität und der Grenzen nicht-deterministischer Systeme
Kommunikationsstärke und Ownership: Du bringst Themen auch ohne Weisungsbefugnis voran und kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder sicher abholen
Deutsch verhandlungssicher und Englisch fließend
Nice-to-have
Erfahrung mit Daten-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekten
Erfahrung mit Legacy- oder Shadow-IT-Ablösungen
Erfahrung in regulierten oder Governance-intensiven Enterprise-Umgebungen
Agile Delivery-Modelle wie Scrum oder SAFe sowie Azure DevOps oder Jira
Kenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur, Vertragsmanagement oder Rechnungsprüfung
Erste Berührungspunkte mit Google Cloud oder vergleichbaren Datenplattformen

30 Tage Urlaub
Attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlicher Erfolgsbeteiligung
Betriebliche Weiterbildung und Entwicklung in Richtung Data & AI
Firmenevents & Company Offsites
Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeitsmodell in Hamburg, Ruhrgebiet und München
Auswahl aus verschiedenen Benefits, z. B. Gym Pass oder Deutschlandticket
Direkter Zugang zu Fachbereichen und Entscheider beim Kunden
Die Möglichkeit, technisch tiefer in Daten, KI und Automatisierung einzusteigen als in vielen klassischen Beratungsrollen
Wir suchen bewusst jemanden auf Mid-Level . Du musst nicht alles am ersten Tag mitbringen. Wichtig sind Prozess- und Datenverständnis, technisches Interesse und die Bereitschaft, tiefer einzusteigen.
Bei uns kannst Du Dich Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickeln: vom Lesen von Datenflüssen zum Verstehen von Code, vom Datenverständnis zum eigenständigen Prüfen mit einfachen SQL-Abfragen oder Skripten und von klassischer Prozessmodellierung hin zu KI-gestützter Analyse und Automatisierung.
So kannst Du zunehmend tiefer in Data, AI und intelligente Prozessautomatisierung einsteigen, ohne Deine Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie aufzugeben.

Business Analyst ServiceNow / Portail DI (f/m/d)
================================================
Be your best with bechtle
-------------------------
Pour l'un de nos clients basé à Genève, nous recherchons un Business Analyst ServiceNow / Portail DI (f/m/d) chargé de faire évoluer les outils et processus digitaux liés aux activités de maintenance et de gestion des infrastructures.
**Ta mission**
* Faire évoluer et administrer le portail intranet dédié aux demandes de travaux et de dépannages, notamment son back\-office ServiceNow, ses indicateurs, tableaux de bord et fonctionnalités.
* Concevoir, structurer et développer le catalogue de prestations techniques, puis accompagner sa mise à disposition sur l'extranet à destination des utilisateurs externes.
* Analyser, formaliser et accompagner la mise en oeuvre des interfaces entre la GMAO et les différents systèmes d'information, notamment ERP, SCADA, BIM, SIG et autres applications métiers.
* Participer aux projets d'évolution des outils de maintenance, incluant les migrations, montées de version, phases d'analyse, conception, tests utilisateurs, documentation et reporting.
* Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'adoption des outils de maintenance par la formation, le support, la conduite du changement et la communication associée.
Ton profil
----------
* Expérience confirmée de 5 à 8 ans en Business Analyse, avec maîtrise de l'élicitation, de la formalisation, de la modélisation des besoins et de l'accompagnement des utilisateurs.
* Expérience significative d'un outil de Service Management, idéalement ServiceNow, ainsi que dans la gestion ou la structuration de catalogues de services.
* Bonne compréhension des environnements applicatifs complexes, des interfaces SI et des API; une expérience d'une GMAO telle que CARL Source constitue un atout.
* Connaissance des outils de reporting et d'analyse, idéalement SAP BusinessObjects WEBI et/ou Power BI, ainsi qu'une expérience en gestion de projets.
* Aisance dans la conduite du changement, la communication avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques et le travail en environnement industriel, technique ou aéroportuaire.
**Notre proposition** * Conditions de travail avantageuses : 6 semaines de vacances par an et un plan de prévoyance attractif
* Développement et mise en valeur du potentiel : vaste gamme de formations professionnelles et personnelles proposées par l'Académie Bechtle
* Diversité : des tâches intéressantes et changeantes dans un secteur tourné vers l'avenir
Numéro d'emploi : PDMOK376

Bechtle Suisse SA

Notre proximité, notre vision globale de l'infrastructure et de la gestion de projets font de nous un acteur incontournable du marché. Nos 1000 collaborateurs motivés sont nos meilleurs atouts pour assurer rapidité, flexibilité et expertise.
